title: Text and rhythm 2
summary: Whole paragraphs, to hold the rhythm past a single line.
intro: You have the whole keyboard now. What is left is not learning keys but holding a rhythm: read ahead, do not stop to look, and do not speed up at the end of a line.
congrats: Whole paragraphs at a steady pace. That is no longer learning to type; it is typing.
